title: Tessera 3.21.2 — TakeOver interval no longer delays the page boot
changes: With a TakeOver interval above 0, ads.js again does at page load what 3.21.0 does there: it defines slots, reserves size-map space, prepares Sticky hosts, decides keyword-conditioned unit rules and sets page-level key-values. 3.21.1 did these at the CMP decision. On pages where the TakeOver can show, only the TakeOver frequency cap, the Google interstitial protection, GPT services, slot display and the first ad requests wait for the visitor's CMP decision.

Ad containers inserted after load and later changes to window.adsKeywords are handled as in 3.21.0. Container discovery (only on pages without content containers at load), the geo_country country pass and the short early keyword check work as in 3.21.0, and only they add later keywords to page key-values or use them for the rules of ad containers. Values are added, not replaced. With a TakeOver interval, on pages where the TakeOver can show, 3.21.1 instead defined containers inserted before the decision and used the keywords current at the decision.

The CMP decision defines no slots for ad containers and adds no window.adsKeywords to page key-values; on an active page it defines the TakeOver guard and the TakeOver slot. The Interstitial fallback rule uses the keywords current when the TakeOver releases the fallback, as in 3.21.0 and 3.21.1. Containers defined while the decision is pending are displayed once after GPT services start. Set window.adsKeywords before ads.js, put the ad containers in the page HTML, and load ads.js with the defer tag shown in implementation.html.

The TakeOver frequency cap is still checked only after the current CMP decision, with the 3.21.1 storage rules. On pages where the TakeOver can show, window.TAKEOVER_ACTIVE_FOR_PAGE is null and the TakeOver status is waiting-consent until the decision, instead of false and inactive. On other pages (in an iframe, or a viewport without a TakeOver size) they are false and inactive, and GPT starts at load, as in 3.21.1.
An active TakeOver still defines its codeless guard before GPT services start. Capped and viewport-skipped pages get no guard and keep the publisher's interstitial attributes.

Without a TakeOver interval the generated script behaves exactly as 3.21.1; only its version label differs. Previous release sources, selected versions and saved packages remain unchanged. Select and save 3.21.2 explicitly to apply this correction.

title: Tessera 3.21.1 — independent audit corrections
changes: Preserve the category/page GPT and Prebid maps when conditional rules do not explicitly override them. Inherited rules report excluded TakeOver and Outstream formats.

Preserve publisher-owned native RTD configuration and diagnose missing modules, an incompatible initial provider list and later configuration changes. Configure all RTD providers together before the wrapper.
TakeOver frequency storage follows the current CMP decision, with page-memory fallback. Debug opt-in no longer reads or writes localStorage.
Previous release sources, selected versions and saved packages remain unchanged. Select and save 3.21.1 explicitly to apply these corrections.

title: Tessera 3.21.0 — explicit contextual IAB signals
changes: Optional exact category mappings with independent IAB Content 2.2 and 3.0 IDs per selected bidder. GAM PPS uses Content 2.2 and explicit page-level ownership.

A custom RTD provider enriches auction-local bidder content without overwriting SChain, foreign first-party data or consent configuration. Missing optional modules and unmapped categories do not block ads.
Diagnostics distinguish configured routes and auction enrichment from unconfirmed SSP taxonomy acceptance. A build kit preserves the saved Prebid module list.
All existing script choices and packages remain unchanged. Select and save 3.21.0 explicitly to use these settings.

title: Tessera 3.20.1 — viewport maps with exact GAM codes
changes: Combines width-and-height viewport maps, conditional category and GEO maps, and consent-gated initial resize recovery with exact GAM ad unit codes.
Keeps periods, leading numbers, Unicode and supported punctuation intact in GPT, Prebid, HTML, CSS and stored packages.
Inactive ad unit bidder overrides stay saved for reactivation and are omitted only from generated active inventory.
Existing script choices and packages remain unchanged. Select and save 3.20.1 explicitly to use the combined behavior.

title: Tessera 3.20.0 — consistent viewport maps and clearer validation
changes: GPT, Prebid and reserved CSS select the same width and height breakpoint. Sticky, page-type and conditional maps retain their configured size limits.
An unmatched map has no eligible sizes; empty rows remain disabled. Existing saved maps are preserved and any added empty baseline is documented in the generated package.
Never-requested ATF Banner and Bottom Sticky can start after an eligible viewport change through the existing consent and lazy-loading gates. Resize does not refresh served or closed positions.
Bidder overrides belonging to disabled or draft positions do not block generation. They remain saved for reactivation; genuinely missing positions still require correction.
Browser viewport conditions are separate from CSS reserved height. Existing site selections, runtime sources and packages remain unchanged until a new version is selected.

title: Tessera 3.19.1 — exact GAM ad unit codes
changes: Preserve GAM codes containing periods, leading numbers, Unicode and supported punctuation through imports, GPT, Prebid and exported markup.
Escape HTML and CSS without changing the saved GAM identity; historical scripts and saved packages remain unchanged.
Use this patch explicitly for existing GAM codes rejected by older script versions. No publisher is upgraded automatically.

title: Tessera 3.19.0 — country rules and GAM targeting
changes: Use geo_country in existing size-map and slot rules. Only dependent positions wait for the bounded country result.
Send the detected country to GAM without delaying other positions or forcing refresh. Unknown stays absent.
Add optional rules to the existing TakeOver Interstitial fallback; external codeless is configured in GAM. Existing site pins and packages remain unchanged.

title: Tessera 3.18.0 — background country recognition
changes: Selecting this version enables one background Cloudflare country lookup per document, shared through window.__AD_GEO.getSnapshot() and ready(). The result describes the network exit, including VPN/proxy exits.

Ads never wait for country detection. A 1500 ms deadline covers both fetch and body; missing data, blocked requests, invalid responses and errors settle to unknown. No retry, cookies, localStorage or shared cache is used.

Country is available for diagnostics and future features. This version does not use it to change CMP decisions, bidders, targeting, size maps or refresh. Duplicate helper loads reuse the same result; a new page load is needed after switching VPN.

Includes the 3.17.0 category-based Banner/Sticky map rules and all inherited consent, refresh and SChain behavior. Existing saved scripts and site selections stay unchanged until an explicit version selection and a newly generated package.

title: Tessera 3.17.0 — page key-value rules for Banner and Sticky
changes: Saved key-value mappings are evaluated on the publisher page using window.adsKeywords, including category. Generating a package does not require a future page value. Default, ATF/BTF and exact position rules support ALL/ANY and the six existing comparison operators.

The first matching enabled rule selects the same responsive map for GPT, Prebid and placeholders. Higher priority runs first; ties retain default/group/exact and saved order. No match uses the directly assigned base map; missing values match only notExists.

The position keeps its decision for the page, including refresh. Set keywords before ads.js. Disabled rules do nothing. Disable slot prevents its GPT slot and Prebid request; Enable does not override disabled inventory.
This version supports conditional Banner and Sticky rules. TakeOver and Outstream retain their reviewed responsive maps and receive a specific message if conditional rules apply.

Existing CMP, readiness, refresh and SChain behavior is retained from 3.16.2. Older runtime source identities, saved site versions and package bytes remain unchanged. Selecting 3.17.0 and generating a new package are explicit actions.

title: Tessera 3.16.2 — empty Sticky retry, inherited refresh visibility threshold and schedule steps
changes: An empty Sticky retry refused by the refresh interval or the minimum wall-clock gap is rescheduled for the exact remaining time instead of stopping Sticky for the rest of the page view. If the device clock moved back and the retry is still refused, it is rescheduled again, at most three times per retry and only while no other Sticky request was made.
The configured retry count, maximum refreshes, Sticky close, page visibility and CMP decision still apply; no request is sent earlier than the saved gap after the previous actual request.
A retry that becomes due on a hidden page, or just as the page is paused, waits for the page to become active again. A gap value computed for one refresh attempt is not reused by a later timer.

A position, including a filled Sticky, whose Default, group and position refresh settings save no minimum in-view percentage uses the inherited threshold at refresh time: 50% unless the Default refresh, or the ATF refresh when there is no Default refresh, saves another value. Saved percentages, including 0, are unchanged, and the view entry and exit thresholds are the same as in 3.16.1.

While a queued content refresh is still waiting to be sent, the content timer already uses the next schedule step, so a later shorter step returns to the 3.16.0 request times when the queued request is sent within that step. With very short steps and slower sends it waits as 3.16.1 did. No request is made before the interval the actual refresh count allows, and refresh counts still advance only for actual requests.
This is the current version for new scripts; a new setup still saves it explicitly. Sites keep their saved exact version, and 3.16.1 stays a stable choice.
Everything else is identical to 3.16.1. 3.16.1 sources, saved configurations and package bytes remain unchanged.

title: Tessera 3.16.1 — verified refresh and delivery corrections
changes: Content refresh follows effective position rules, including the inherited 30-second baseline after explicit selection. Explicitly disabled rules stay disabled. Sticky follows inherited schedules, retries empty responses and resumes after duplicate tab-pause events.

Minimum wall-clock gap applies from actual GPT dispatch, including the initial request. Automatic-refresh counts advance only for actual allowed requests; request reporting keeps interval and gap semantics explicit.
Empty, invalid or timed-out TakeOver releases one consent-gated Interstitial fallback. Viewport-disabled TakeOver skips safely and reports current map dimensions.

Late configured wrappers are discovered for a bounded 20-second window using id, data-ad, data-slot and data-gpt. Configured lazy rules retain request ownership; this is not general infinite-scroll support.

Lazy targeting is rechecked against current-auction, unexpired native Prebid bids, including Send All Bids keys. One replacement auction is allowed when all prior bids expire; safe GAM-only fallback remains after a consent change.

Late window.adsKeywords is polled for 2.5 seconds. SChain replacement-sensitive values remain exact, Sticky CSS names are valid, duplicate render reads are removed and generated wrapper syntax is checked as ES2015.

Existing 3.16.0 sources, saved configurations and package bytes remain unchanged. Selecting this version is explicit; CMP authority, original Outstream restrictions and historical catalog defaults remain intact.

title: Tessera 3.16.0
changes: Independent Tessera runtime for GAM / AdX only or GAM + Prebid, with CMP decision readiness, responsive inventory, per-position lazy loading, TakeOver and GAM request reporting.

Native Send All Bids, Deals and responsive PubMatic Outstream. Video uses verified Prebid 11.34.0, supported VAST cache and a compatible selected creative on standard in-page positions, with automatic refresh disabled.
Exact stable source identity and Tessera package documentation. Previous runtime sources, saved selections and packages remain unchanged; upgrades require an explicit save.

title: Responsive Outstream sizes from the position map
changes: Video uses an eligible size from each enabled width breakpoint in the size map. A single size is automatic; choose from the map when several sizes are eligible. Height breakpoints require minimum height 0 in this pilot.
Resolves dimensions again when the auction starts, including delayed consent and lazy loading. Pending video with a different active size cannot render.
Banner sizes, existing fixed video settings, older runtime sources and saved packages remain unchanged. This preview requires explicit selection.

title: Outstream checks the position display
changes: Allows Standard Outstream positions alongside a separate legacy TakeOver.
Respects explicitly disabled Sticky and identifies the actual display in validation errors.
Keeps Sticky, TakeOver and its Interstitial fallback outside the Outstream pilot. Existing versions and saved packages remain unchanged.

title: Deals and PubMatic Banner + Outstream pilot
changes: Combines completed CMP readiness with native Send All Bids; configured IDs never fabricate bids or consent.
Adds per-partner, per-position deals with dates and a read-only GAM plan. Native targeting exposes one selected bid per bidder; unverified aliases are excluded.
Adds an explicitly activated PubMatic outstream pilot using checked Prebid 11.34.0, a native renderer and compatible GAM creative. Video positions do not auto-refresh.
Old runtime selections and saved packages remain unchanged. Hosted renderer lifecycle, revenue and partner activation still require isolated verification.

title: Consent readiness and reliable initial ad requests
changes: Waits for a completed CMP decision; unknown scope or a pending choice never becomes an NPA fallback.
Separates Prebid loading, pre-auction readiness and the actual auction deadline; missing Prebid falls back to GAM only after a completed CMP decision.
Late or incomplete auctions cannot add stale bid targeting or repeat an initial request. Native GPT and Prebid retain TCF enforcement, including rejection.
Explicit opt-in for newly generated packages. Existing selections, old generators and saved package bytes remain unchanged. Direct ID5-to-PPID copying is disabled pending its separate consent review.

title: Reliable GAM refresh and Prebid auction reporting
changes: Adds refresh count, bucket, selected interval and request policy to all demand modes.
GAM-only sends no Prebid auction labels. Completed Prebid auctions report unique positive bids, distinct bidders and the actual auction timeout flag.
Keeps version 3.10 delivery, consent, lazy loading and refresh scheduling. Does not include the separate creative bridge or Tanjug cache engine.
Older versions, saved packages and existing selections remain unchanged. Key definitions and GAM reporting setup are included in the package.

title: TakeOver in Ad positions and saved lazy rules
changes: Configure TakeOver as an ad position with a responsive size map, closing timers and a per-tab display interval.
Choose GAM only or the site Prebid bidders; ad-unit and device bidder overrides apply to TakeOver.
Saved lazy fetch/render rules work in the built-in generator.
The previous 3.9.1 generator remains bundled and selectable for compatible settings; saved packages retain their original files.

title: Prebid configuration support
changes: Currency conversion follows the option selected for the site.
Prebid file checks identify missing modules and the bidder or feature requiring them.
The built-in generator continues to produce ads.js, ads.min.js and CSS from the saved site settings.

title: Built-in generator and complete test package
changes: Generate the wrapper directly in Tessera without uploading an ads.js template.
Package readable and minified JavaScript, CSS, configuration, manifest and installation instructions together.
Retain the reference 3.9.1 TakeOver behavior and verify the original Prebid file when enabled.
